metadata.description: Official Couchbase marketplace for Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: couchbase
plugins.description: Official Couchbase plugin (MCP Server + Skills). Connect to a live Couchbase cluster, explore data, write and run SQL++ queries, optimize queries and GSI indexes, and design data models — grounded in your real cluster via the Couchbase MCP server.

plugins.name: couchbase-mobile
plugins.description: Build an offline-first Couchbase Mobile app — iOS (Swift) or Android (Kotlin/Compose) — with Capella App Services sync. Provisions the backend and generates a runnable app project that keeps working through network drops and reconciles on reconnect.
